caption: The drawing depicts three geometric, architectural-like objects arranged in a vertical formation on an off-white or beige background. The upper object is a shaded, detailed rendering of an octagonal or multi-sided window or frame with thick, beveled borders in dark gray and black tones. Inside the frame are two vertical and one horizontal element, with the horizontal element containing a symmetrical, double-curved cutout. Directly below, there is a larger, lightly drawn pencil sketch representing the same structure, showing its overall shape and interior features in a simplified outline, including the door-like division and the central plate with a bowtie-shaped cutout. To the right of this lower sketch, there is a smaller pencil outline giving a side or sectional view, showing the thickness and profile of the object as well as the central cutout section. The composition places the more detailed, colored view at the top, with the less detailed, technical sketches below. The artist's name, "John Ditterich," appears in small cursive script in the lower left corner of the paper.
title: Buckles
